aboutPreview.headline: Building Reliable Solutions for a Stronger Future
aboutPreview.body: EXPERT TECHNICAL CONTRACTING AND SERVICES is a trusted provider of comprehensive contracting and industrial solutions across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. With extensive industry expertise and a commitment to operational excellence, we deliver high-quality services that support the successful execution of projects across multiple sectors.
aboutPreview.body2: Our company is driven by innovation, technical expertise, and a customer-focused approach, enabling us to provide dependable solutions tailored to the evolving needs of our clients. From project planning to final delivery, we are dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, and efficiency.

servicesPreview.headline: Four divisions, one integrated promise
servicesPreview.subheadline: From coatings and fabrication to civil construction and solar energy — a single source for the lifecycle of your industrial asset.

categories.industrialDescription: Coating, insulation, fabrication, fireproofing and waste management for refineries and process plants.
categories.constructionDescription: Civil construction, renovation and operation & maintenance for residential, commercial and industrial facilities.
categories.engineeringDescription: Electrical & Instrumentation, mechanical works, PEB buildings and solar energy solutions.
categories.supplyDescription: Manpower, rental equipment and industrial material supply to keep your operations running.

visionMission.visionBody: To shape the future of contracting and industrial services in the Middle East by setting new benchmarks in innovation, reliability, and operational excellence — becoming the partner of choice for clients who value quality, trust, and long-term success.
visionMission.missionBody: To deliver reliable, efficient, and value-driven solutions through a skilled workforce, advanced technical capabilities, and a strong commitment to client success. We strive to complete every project with professionalism, integrity, and uncompromising quality standards.

about.hseBody: We operate to international Health, Safety, Environment and Quality standards on every site. Zero-harm is non-negotiable. Our QA/QC discipline starts before mobilisation and continues through hand-over.
